scope: AI-assisted content review of all 38 cross-publication nodes in the existing round2 20-patent baseline. Not independent human gold and not an LLM judge API experiment.
membership_rule: Union node.source_id and kv_store_entity_chunks.chunk_ids; map each chunk.full_doc_id to full_docs publication header; deduplicate canonical publication numbers. Raw extraction rows cross-check attribution but do not silently add graph sources.

categories.shared_specific_concept: At each source the node denotes the same reasonably specific technical concept; distinct document implementations are not claimed to be the same individual instance.
categories.shared_broad_class: Sources support a common broad class/role, while implementations or instances differ. A generic label alone is not an error.
categories.contextual_conflation: Concrete source quotes establish distinct senses or non-interchangeable document-local roles collapsed into one ID. Must explain why a common class interpretation is insufficient for the asserted node semantics; mere differing application contexts are not enough.
categories.insufficient_evidence: Available original/extraction/graph evidence does not support a confident semantic decision. Specify missing or ambiguous evidence.

instance_rule: Record concept_class_vs_local_instance explicitly. Shared class is separate from identity equality; graph coalescence alone does not prove same-individual identity or wrong-edge propagation.
edge_rule: Inspect actual incident edges and their source mappings. Distinguish shared-node cross-document adjacency/possible unscoped path composition from an observed unsupported edge. Do not claim actual retrieval/generation propagation without saved evidence.
quote_rule: Each publication gets at least one exact contiguous short quote from the indexed full document and a source chunk containing it; claim number checked against saved claims JSON. Preserve exact punctuation/spelling; use multiple quote fields rather than invented ellipses.
